2610.11410.title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
2610.11410.paper_summary: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE
2610.11410.paper_summary_zh: 情感計算已從類別情感識別進展到使用大型多模態模型的開放式情感分析。然後，情感科學將情感描述為一個由評估、調節和社會詮釋塑造的展開過程，這在計算上仍然未被充分探索。我們提出了TRACE，一個以認知為導向的框架，通過三個相互關聯的階段來形式化情感事件：條件、情感和效果，將可觀察的線索與內部立場和情感表達調節等認知因素整合在一起。基於這一公式，TRACE-Bench通過五個任務評估多模態模型在現實社會場景中的表現，這些任務涵蓋了基於情感的識別、調節解碼、因果推理、效果推理和全鏈重建，包含3,746對結構化的問題-答案對，涉及646個視頻。與人類模型的匹配比較顯示出顯著的性能差距，而專注於情感的模型通常也落後於通用的MLLM。模型輸出顯示出反覆的失敗，包括將顯示的行為視為真實的感受，以及在長鏈生成過程中虛構不支持的事件。我們進一步提出TRACER，一種以認知為基礎的結構推理方法，將每個推理與來自事實觀察、認知評估和既定上游結論的明確前提相結合，形成一個可追溯的中間和目標結論圖。TRACER在五個任務中超越了所有評估的模型基準。項目頁面：https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE
